verses.en: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
verses.pt: Foram estes os filhos de Israel: Rúben, Simeão, Levi, Judá, Issacar, Zebulom,
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
verses.en_bbe: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi and Judah, Issachar and Zebulun;

verses.en: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.pt: Dã, José, Benjamim, Naftali, Gade e Aser.
verses.en_web: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.en_bbe: Dan, Joseph and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

verses.en: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD; and he slew him.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Judá: Er, Onã e Selá; estes três lhe nasceram da filha de Suá, a cananéia. E Er, o primogênito de Judá, foi mau aos olhos do Senhor, que o matou:
verses.en_web: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah; which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s sight; and he killed him.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan and Shelah; these three were his sons by Bathshua, the Canaanite woman. And Er, Judah's oldest son, did evil in the eyes of the Lord; and he put him to death.

verses.en: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
verses.pt: Tamar, nora de Judá, lhe deu à luz Pérez e Zerá. Ao todo os filhos de Judá foram cinco.
verses.en_web: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
verses.en_bbe: And Tamar, his daughter-in-law, had Perez and Zerah by him. All the sons of Judah were five.

verses.en: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Perez: Hezrom e Hamul:
verses.en_web: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

verses.en: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Zerá: Zinri, Etã, Hemã, Calcol e Dara; cinco ao todo.
verses.en_web: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara; five of them in all.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Zerah: Zimri and Ethan and Heman and Calcol and Dara; five of them.

verses.en: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Carmi: Acar, o perturbador de Israel, que pecou no anátema.
verses.en_web: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Carmi: Achan, the troubler of Israel, who did wrong about the cursed thing.

verses.en: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.
verses.pt: De Etã foi filho Azarias.
verses.en_web: The son of Ethan: Azariah.
verses.en_bbe: And the son of Ethan: Azariah.

verses.en: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
verses.pt: Os filhos que nasceram a Hezrom: Jerameel, Rão e Quelubai.
verses.en_web: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Hezron, the offspring of his body: Jerahmeel and Ram and Chelubai.

verses.en: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
verses.pt: Rão foi pai de Aminadabe, e Aminadabe de Nasom, príncipe dos filhos de Judá;
verses.en_web: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
verses.en_bbe: And Ram was the father of Amminadab; and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, chief of the children of Judah;

verses.en: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
verses.pt: Nason foi pai de Salmom, e Salmom de Boaz;
verses.en_web: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,
verses.en_bbe: And Nahshon was the father of Salma, and Salma was the father of Boaz,

verses.en: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,
verses.pt: Boaz foi pai de Obede, e Obede de Jessé;
verses.en_web: and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse;
verses.en_bbe: And Boaz was the father of Obed, and Obed was the father of Jesse,

verses.en: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,
verses.pt: a Jessé nasceram Eliabe, seu primogênito, Abinadabe o segundo, Siméia o terceiro,
verses.en_web: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third,
verses.en_bbe: And Jesse was the father of Eliab, his oldest son, and Abinadab, the second, and Shimea, the third,

verses.en: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
verses.pt: Netanel o quarto, Radai o quinto,
verses.en_web: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
verses.en_bbe: Nethanel, the fourth, Raddai, the fifth,

verses.en: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:
verses.pt: Ozen o sexto e Davi o sétimo;
verses.en_web: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh;
verses.en_bbe: Ozem, the sixth, David, the seventh;

verses.en: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
verses.pt: e foram suas irmãs Zeruia e Abigail. Os filhos de Zeruia foram: Abisai, Joabe e Asael, três.
verses.en_web: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.
verses.en_bbe: And their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And Zeruiah had three sons: Abishai and Joab and Asahel.

verses.en: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite.
verses.pt: Abigail deu à luz Amasa; o pai de Amasa foi Jeter, o ismaelita.
verses.en_web: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
verses.en_bbe: And Abigail was the mother of Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

verses.en: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.pt: A Calebe, filho de Hezrom, nasceram filhos de Azuba, sua mulher, e de Jeriote; e os filhos dela foram estes: Jeser, Sobabe e Ardom.
verses.en_web: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.en_bbe: And Caleb, the son of Hezron, had children by Azubah his wife, the daughter of Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher and Shobab and Ardon.

verses.en: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.
verses.pt: Morreu Azuba; e Calebe tomou para si Efrata, da qual lhe nasceu Hur.
verses.en_web: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
verses.en_bbe: And after the death of Azubah, Caleb took as his wife Ephrath, who was the mother of Hur.

verses.en: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.
verses.pt: Hur foi pai de îri, e îri de Bezaleel.
verses.en_web: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.
verses.en_bbe: And Hur was the father of Uri; and Uri was the father of Bezalel.

verses.en: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.
verses.pt: Então Hezrom, tendo já sessenta anos, tomou por mulher a filha de Maquir, pai de Gileade; e conheceu-a, e ela lhe deu à luz Segube.
verses.en_web: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.
verses.en_bbe: And after that, Hezron had connection with the daughter of Machir, the father of Gilead, whom he took as his wife when he was sixty years old; and she had Segub by him.

verses.en: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.pt: Segube foi pai de Jair, o qual veio a ter vinte e três cidades na terra de Gileade.
verses.en_web: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.en_bbe: And Segub was the father of Jair, who had twenty-three towns in the land of Gilead.

verses.en: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.pt: Mas Gesur e Arã tomaram deles Havote-Jair, e Quenate e suas aldeias, sessenta cidades. Todos estes foram filhos de Maquir, pai de Gileade.
verses.en_web: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.en_bbe: And Geshur and Aram took the tent-towns of Jair from them, with Kenath and the small places round it, even sixty towns. All these were the sons of Machir, the father of Gilead.

verses.en: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephratah, then Abiah Hezron’s wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.
verses.pt: Depois da morte de Hezrom, em Calebe de Efrata, Abia, mulher de Hezrom, lhe deu Asur, pai de Tecoa.
verses.en_web: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah Hezron’s wife bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
verses.en_bbe: And after the death of Hezron, Caleb had connection with Ephrath, his father Hezron's wife, and she gave birth to his son Asshur, the father of Tekoa.

verses.en: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Jerameel, primogênito de Jezrom, foram: Rão, o primogênito, Buna, Orem, Ozem e Aías.
verses.en_web: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Jerahmeel, the oldest son of Hezron, were Ram, the oldest, and Bunah and Oren and Ozem and Ahijah.

verses.en: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
verses.pt: Jerameel teve outra mulher, cujo nome era Atara, a qual foi mãe de Onã.
verses.en_web: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.
verses.en_bbe: And Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah: she was the mother of Onam.

verses.en: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Rão, primogênito de Jerameel, foram: Maaz, Jamim e Equer.
verses.en_web: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Ram, the oldest son of Jerahmeel, were Maaz and Jamin and Eker.

verses.en: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Onã, foram: Samai e Jada; e os filhos de Samai: Nadabe e Abisur.
verses.en_web: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada; and the sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

verses.en: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.
verses.pt: O nome da mulher de Abisur era Abiail, que lhe deu à luz Abã e Molide.
verses.en_web: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molid.
verses.en_bbe: And the name of Abishur's wife was Abihail; and she had Ahban and Molid by him.

verses.en: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Nadabe: Selede e Apaim; e Selede morreu sem filhos.
verses.en_web: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled came to his end without sons.

verses.en: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.
verses.pt: O filho de Apaim: Isi; o filho de Isi: Sesã; o filho de Sesã: Alai.
verses.en_web: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Appaim: Ishi. And the sons of Ishi: Sheshan. And the sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.

verses.en: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Jada, irmão de Samai: Jeter e Jônatas; e Jeter morreu sem filhos.
verses.en_web: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Jada, the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether came to his end without sons.

verses.en: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Jônatas: Pelete e Zaza. Esses foram os filhos de Jerameel.
verses.en_web: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

verses.en: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
verses.pt: Sesã não teve filhos, mas filhas. E tinha Sesã um servo egípcio, cujo nome era Jará:
verses.en_web: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
verses.en_bbe: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. And Sheshan had an Egyptian servant, whose name was Jarha.

verses.en: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.
verses.pt: Deu, pois, Sesã sua filha por mulher a Jará, seu servo; e ela lhe deu à luz Atai.
verses.en_web: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.
verses.en_bbe: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha, his servant, as a wife; and she had Attai by him.

verses.en: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
verses.pt: Atai foi pai de Natã, Natã de Zabade,
verses.en_web: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,
verses.en_bbe: And Attai was the father of Nathan, and Nathan was the father of Zabad,

verses.en: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,
verses.pt: Zabade de Eflal, Eflal de Obede,
verses.en_web: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,
verses.en_bbe: And Zabad was the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal was the father of Obed,

verses.en: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,
verses.pt: Obede de Jeú, Jeú de Azarias,
verses.en_web: and Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,
verses.en_bbe: And Obed was the father of Jehu, and Jehu was the father of Azariah,

verses.en: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,
verses.pt: Azarias de Helez, Helez de Eleasá,
verses.en_web: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,
verses.en_bbe: And Azariah was the father of Helez, and Helez was the father of Eleasah,

verses.en: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,
verses.pt: Eleasá de Sismai, Sismai de Salum,
verses.en_web: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,
verses.en_bbe: And Eleasah was the father of Sismai, and Sismai was the father of Shallum,

verses.en: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.
verses.pt: Salum de Jecamias, e Jecamias de Elisama.
verses.en_web: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.
verses.en_bbe: And Shallum was the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.

verses.en: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Calebe, irmão de Jerameel: Messa, seu primogênito, que foi o pai de Zife, e os filhos de Maressa, pai de Hebrom.
verses.en_web: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel, were Mareshah, his oldest son, who was the father of Ziph and Hebron.

verses.en: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Hebrom: Corá, Tapua, Requem e Sema.
verses.en_web: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Hebron: Korah and Tappuah and Rekem and Shema.

verses.en: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.
verses.pt: Sema foi pai de Raão, pai de Jorqueão; e Requem foi pai de Samai.
verses.en_web: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.
verses.en_bbe: And Shema was the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem was the father of Shammai.

verses.en: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
verses.pt: O filho de Samai foi Maom; e Maom foi pai de Bete-Zur.
verses.en_web: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.
verses.en_bbe: And the son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.

verses.en: And Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.
verses.pt: Efá, a concubina de Calebe, teve Harã, Moza e Gazez; e Harã foi pai de Gazez.
verses.en_web: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.
verses.en_bbe: And Ephah, Caleb's servant-wife, had Haran and Moza and Gazez; and Haran was the father of Gazez.

verses.en: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Gesham, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Jadai: Regem, Jotão, Gesã, Pelete, Efá e Saafe.
verses.en_web: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Jahdai: Regem and Jotham and Geshan and Pelet and Ephah and Shaaph.

verses.en: Maachah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.
verses.pt: Maacá, concubina de Calebe, deu à luz Seber e Tiraná.
verses.en_web: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.
verses.en_bbe: Maacah, Caleb's servant-wife, was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah,

verses.en: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsa.
verses.pt: Deu à luz também Saafe, pai de Madmana, e Seva, pai de Macbena e de Gibeá; e a filha de Calebe foi Acsa.
verses.en_web: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena, and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
verses.en_bbe: And Shaaph, the father of Madmannah, Sheva, the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and Caleb's daughter was Achsah. These were the sons of Caleb.

verses.en: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim,
verses.pt: Estes foram os filhos de Calebe, filho de Hur, o primogênito de Efrata: Sobal, pai de Quiriate-Jearim,
verses.en_web: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Hur, the oldest son of Ephrathah; Shobal, the father of Kiriath-jearim,

verses.en: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
verses.pt: Salma, pai de Belém, e Harefe, pai de Bete-Gader.
verses.en_web: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.
verses.en_bbe: Salma, the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph, the father of Beth-gader.

verses.en: And Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Sobal, pai de Quiriate-Jearim, foram: Haroé e metade dos menuotes.
verses.en_web: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.
verses.en_bbe: And Shobal, the father of Kiriath-jearim, had sons: Haroeh, half of the Manahathites.

verses.en: And the families of Kirjath-jearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.
verses.pt: As famílias de Quiriate-Jearim: os itreus, os puteus, os sumateus e os misraeus; destes saíram os zorateus e os estaloeus.
verses.en_web: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
verses.en_bbe: And the families of Kiriath-jearim: the Ithrites and the Puthites and the Shumathites and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

verses.en: The sons of Salma; Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Salma: Belém, os netofatitas, Atarote-Bete-Joabe, metade dos manaatitas e os zoritas.
verses.en_web: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Salma: Beth-lehem and the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-Joab and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

verses.en: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.
verses.pt: As famílias dos escribas que habitavam em Jabes: os tiratitas, os simeatitas e os sucatitas; estes são os queneus que descenderam de Hamate, pai da casa de Recabe.
verses.en_web: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
verses.en_bbe: And the families of scribes who were living at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, the Sucathites. These are the Kenites, the offspring of Hammath, the father of the family of Rechab.
